1879073737.name: Piercing Attack
1879073737.desc: An attack with your sharp talons deals damage and causes the target to bleed.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>Ignores 50% of your target's mitigations.</rgb>

1879104841.name: Curse of Sticky Feet
1879104841.desc: Coats the opponent's feet in a sticky substance that slows their movement speed.

1879136969.name: Thrash
1879136969.desc: You savagely attack multiple enemies. Each attack leaves a savage wound, causing your target to take damage over time. Each stack of Savage Wound does 25% more damage.

1879138633.name: Curse of Rotten Flesh
1879138633.desc: You plague your target with spores, attacking their defences.

1879176393.name: Fighting Withdrawal
1879176393.desc: Breaks the effects of Dazes, Stuns and Knockdowns.

1879212105.name: Doom-shroom
1879212105.desc: It's kinda like a gross piñata, except instead of giving you candy it gives you gross.

1879213897.name: Deep Wounds (Melee)
1879213897.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's scales, tearing them loose and exposing what lies beneath.

1879221577.name: Brawler: Quit Whining and Fight!
1879221577.desc: Exhort and deride your allies, restoring some of their health. Heals all allies within radius.

1879242313.name: Bond of the Rider
1879242313.desc: So complete is the Lore-master's understanding and bond with their War-steed that they can influence the morale and state of a war-steed.

1879244873.name: Shield the Flank
1879244873.desc: The ultimate expression of tactical horsemanship, this is a dangerous strike on its own; when enhanced by the Rohirrim Discipline your defensive capacity is increased.

1879245641.name: Fixation of Storm
1879245641.desc: The chilling nature of frost is coupled with runes of longevity to impose the a bone-numbing slow to come over an enemy targets.

1879272265.name: Static Surge
1879272265.desc: A powerful attack that deals lightning damage in front of the Rune-keeper.

1879277001.name: Tripwire
1879277001.desc: A tripwire trap can knock a monster down, sometimes creating the opportunity to use a Fellowship Manoeuvre.\n\nTrap remains for 1 minute after being placed.

1879302601.name: Call to Arms: Archer (Maid-at-arms)
1879302601.desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879305545.name: Rain of Arrows: Light From The Sky
1879305545.desc: Rains arrows down upon your enemies, allowing you to hit multiple targets.\n\nArrows inflict Light damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879315145.name: Snap Shot - Stealthed Ambush of Light
1879315145.desc: When attacking from stealth, a Warden can deliver a powerful opening volley.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Knockout replaced with a mount turn rate debuff</rgb>

1879316041.name: Armour Crush
1879316041.desc: You strike your opponent across the face with your paw, increasing the damage they take for a duration.

1879360841.name: Red Snake
1879360841.desc: Brings out a striped snake to keep you company.

1879368649.name: Mottled Goat Kid
1879368649.desc: Brings out a mottled goat kid to keep you company.

1879405385.name: Anniversary Celebration Pig
1879405385.desc: Brings out a friendly pig pulling a cart of fireworks for a most special celebration.

1879411785.name: Joy of Battle - Heal
1879411785.desc:
Few arts require as strong a constitution as the Brawler's method of battle, and they soon come to relish tests of their limits.

For a short duration, any strikes you make will heal the Brawler for a small portion of their Maximum Morale. 

Using one 'Joy of Battle' skill will trigger the cooldown for both 'Joy of Battle' skills.

1879447369.name: Anniversary Celebration Corgi
1879447369.desc: Brings out a friendly corgi pulling a cart of fireworks for a most special celebration.

1879451337.name: Curse-shouter Stance
1879451337.desc: You focus your energy on crippling your opponents' will to fight.\n\nOnly one stance may be active at a time. You can only change stances outside of combat.

1879452361.name: Friendly Egret
1879452361.desc: Summons a beautiful egret to accompany you on your journeys.

1879486025.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Umbari Guardsman)
1879486025.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879492169.name: Scorn
1879492169.desc: Your viscious scorn helps your target to realize they have no choice but to win this fight.

1879500361.name: Mushroom Hunter's Corgi
1879500361.desc: Summons a friendly corgi pulling a mushroom collection cart.

1879507657.name: Oromë's Arrow
1879507657.desc: A damaging shot that cleanses foul corruptions.

1879522377.name: Routing Cry (Defeat)
1879522377.desc: Deals Light damage to nearby foes, and draws threat from nearby fellows to yourself.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879528265.name: Prepared: Wisp of Flame
1879528265.desc: Adherents of Balefire have learned to harness power as their enemy burns.

conditionalEffects.description: Flame Wisp, Spike, and Breath gain the ability to tier up the Ignite effect if present, up to Tier 3.

1879528777.name: Prepared: Fire-spike
1879528777.desc: Send a spike of fire at your target, dealing damage and applying a persistent burn.
